meta.scope: Paraguay batch 2 — External sector (BOP, trade), monetary policy rate & reserves, soy/beef/energy anchors, and maquila.

candidates.title: Balanza de Pagos / Balance of Payments
candidates.description: Quarterly and annual balance of payments covering the current account, capital/financial account and changes in reserve assets.
candidates.notes: Core external-accounts product. Current-account outcomes swing with commodity cycles and energy exports; goods trade is typically strong when soy and beef perform well.

candidates.title: Reporte de Comercio Exterior / Merchandise Trade
candidates.description: Monthly and annual statistics of exports and imports of goods, including registered trade, re-exports and other flows. Key traditional exports: soy and derivatives, beef, electricity, maize.
candidates.notes: Primary high-frequency trade product. 2025 total exports ~USD 16.7 bn. Soy, beef, maize and electricity dominate; re-exports and maquila are material secondary flows.

candidates.title: Tasa de Política Monetaria (TPM) / Policy interest rate
candidates.description: Main monetary-policy instrument of the BCP under the inflation-targeting regime.
candidates.notes: Operational policy rate. Recent levels around 5.5%. Adjusted to steer inflation toward the target band.

candidates.title: Reservas Internacionales / International reserves
candidates.description: Stock of international reserve assets managed by the central bank. Published at high frequency and analysed in the BOP and monetary reports.
candidates.notes: Key external-buffer indicator. Continuously monitored alongside the net international investment position.

candidates.title: Marco de metas de inflación — BCP
candidates.description: Operational monetary-policy framework: explicit inflation targeting. The BCP sets a target (historically 4%, more recently centred near 3.5%) with a ±2 pp tolerance band and uses the TPM as the primary instrument.
referenced_by: IPC and inflation analysis that refers to the target band
Market and academic commentary on Paraguayan monetary policy
candidates.notes: Core policy-framework node. Continuously cited as the reference against which inflation outcomes and policy actions are evaluated.

candidates.title: Soja y derivados — producción y exportaciones
candidates.description: Statistics of soybean and soybean-product production and exports. Single most important merchandise export and the backbone of the agricultural economy.
candidates.notes: Structural export leader. Often 30–40%+ of registered export value in strong years. Continuously cited in trade, BOP and rural-economy analysis.

candidates.title: Carne bovina — producción y exportaciones
candidates.description: Statistics of beef production and exports. Major traditional agro-export alongside soy.
candidates.notes: Signature traditional export. Paraguay is a significant regional and global beef exporter; volumes and values are high-frequency trade indicators.

candidates.title: Exportaciones de energía eléctrica (Itaipú / Yacyretá)
candidates.description: Statistics of electricity exports from the binational hydroelectric plants (Itaipú with Brazil, Yacyretá with Argentina). Unique and material component of Paraguay’s external accounts.
candidates.notes: Distinctive structural feature of the Paraguayan economy. Electricity sales to Brazil (and to a lesser extent Argentina) are a recurring and large line in the trade and current-account statistics.

candidates.title: Itaipú Binacional — institutional and statistical identity
candidates.description: Binational hydroelectric entity shared with Brazil. Generates the bulk of Paraguay’s electricity export revenue and is a foundational infrastructure and fiscal-revenue node.
candidates.notes: Foundational binational instrument. Continuously cited in energy, trade and public-finance analysis; the treaty and compensation arrangements are recurring reference points.

candidates.title: Régimen de Maquila / Maquila exports
candidates.publisher: BCP / Consejo Nacional de Industrias Maquiladoras
candidates.description: Statistics of exports under the maquila (in-bond manufacturing) regime. Growing industrial-export channel, especially toward Brazil and other MERCOSUR markets.
candidates.notes: Important industrial-export line. 2025 maquila exports ~USD 1.2 bn. Complements the primary-commodity export base with light manufacturing and assembly.

proposed_edges.basis: Balance of payments is compiled by the Banco Central del Paraguay.
Merchandise trade flows are a primary input into the goods account of the balance of payments.
The policy rate is the primary instrument used to steer inflation toward the target.
The Monetary Policy Report analyses outcomes against the inflation target.
Changes in reserve assets appear in the balance of payments.
Soy and derivatives are the leading merchandise export line.
Beef is a major traditional export line.
Electricity exports from the binational plants are a distinctive and large trade line.
Itaipú is the principal source of the electricity export statistics.
Maquila exports are a distinct and growing component of total exports.
